RADIO SYSTEM WITH CASSETTE PLAYER

RADIO SPECIFICATIONS

The main technical specification of the radio are:

  • Tuner 2IC with SHARX function and Hicut adjustment (reduction of interference)
  • integrated CC player
  • CC interface with ASCI-BUS for CD-Changer
  • Integrated display
  • CAN interface
  • Telephone input
  • Preparation for remote control
  • Soft-Mute function

CAN bus functions:

  • On control (for switching off logic)
  • External display interface, see instrument panel connector DOT matrix display
  • Speed volume control
  • Anti-theft code
  • Lighting control

Electrical specifications:

  • Operating voltage: from 10 to 16 V
  • Nominal supply voltage: 13.5 V
  • Minimum memory supply voltage: 5 V
  • Operating voltage limit: 18 V for 1 hour; 24 V for 1 min
  • Max. current absorption: 10A
  • Stand by current: < 2 mA
  • Stand by current 10 secs after first connection: 30 mA
  • Output channels: 4
  • Audio power 4x40 watt

COMPOSITION OF RADIO SYSTEM

The mid level radio system consists of a radio with a CC cassette player interfaced with mid/high level speakers and has a radio aerial or, if there is preparation for a radio phone, it has a dual function aerial.

It can operate a CD-changer, if fitted, and can be operated by outside controls.

Main functions

The equipment is switched on using the on button

The equipment is supplied by pressing the ON button for more than 20 msec. The display responds immediately (within 1 sec., last source indication), the audio can be heard within 2.5 secs.

To switch the equipment off, press the ON button for more than 1 sec.

On/off logic, hour mode

It switches off automatically 20 minutes after the ignition has been switched off. The radio can be switched on, for a futher 20 minutes, after it has been switched off automatically, by pressing the On button.

Automatic tuning

Press the up / down button (^/v) briefly (<1 sec.) to start the automatic tuning into the next station that can be received in the direction selected. If the button is pressed for longer (>1 sec) the rapid search will start. Once the first station with good reception is tuned into, the tuner will stop for 1 sec (in mute) before the rapid search resumes. When the button is released, the tuner stops at the first station which can be received.

If the traffic information function is activated, the system only searches for stations broadcasing traffic news.

If the PTY function is activated, then the system will only search for PTY stations.

During the search, the display alternately shows the type of the programme and the word SEARCH (every 2 secs).

If the frequency is identical to the frequency programmed during preselection on the same band (FM1, FM2, FMT, MW, LW) the preselection number will appear on the display for 5 secs.

The outer display will show the word SEARCH during the automatic search.

Manual tuning

To start the gradual tuning in the direction selected, press the left / right button (<</>>) briefly (<1 sec). If the button is pressed for longer (>1 sec) then the rapid function is implemented as long as the button remains pressed.

The speaker for the HI FI systems which are matched with BOSE systems have coaxial specifications, i.e. a single container houses a mid-range and a tweeter. The speaker has one single supply connector.

Composition

Location

Type

The high fidelity BOSE speakers are composed of a magnetic ferrite core for both the mide range speakers and the tweeter, in addition, the mid range speakers have a treated paper membrane and textile material. The moving coil support is made from aluminium.

The tweeters have a plastic membrane and a support for fitting co-axially on the mid- range.

AMPLIFIER

Specifcations

It is a 5 channel, hifi amplifier with 200W power, 4 analogue amplifiers and a 100W class D impulse amplifier.

The amplifier has 4 stereo channels for the speakers in the front and rear doors and a mono channel for the rear woofer.

The amplifier is equipped with a built in equalizer and compressor.

The high resolution equalizer is specially calibrated in the vehicle passenger compartment because it takes into account the vehicle absorption and reflection surfaces (seats, windows, dashboard, door panels) and the position of the speakers and the passengers.

The 'two stage' technology allows high power with compact dimensions and reduced heat emission compared with a traditional linear amplifier.

The amplifier is fitted with:

  • an integrated signal processor, which actively adapts the bass;
  • an active equalizer, with automatic electronic balancing of all outputs
  • an integrated compressor which minimizes distortions

Composition

Location

It is located in the rear compartment on the left hand side.

Starting from January 2004, a new 5000 series amplifier will be fitted with the same specifications as the previous one but with more advanced technological solutions.
